subject: general
question: At which place ARTPARK, India's first AI and Robotics Technology Park was launched with a seed funding of ₹230 crore, in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ARTPARK** (AI & Robotics Technology Park) was launched in **Bengaluru**.
 
• It is India's **first AI and Robotics Technology Park**.
 
• The park was initiated with a seed funding of **₹230 crore**.
 
• The funding was provided by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS).
 
• The primary objective of ARTPARK is to promote technology innovations in AI and robotics, supporting startups and research in these fields.
 
• ARTPARK aims to create a collaborative ecosystem bringing together academia, industry, and government to drive technological advancements and commercialization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ARTPARK** is hosted at the **Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru**.
 
• The initiative is expected to foster interdisciplinary research and innovation in AI and robotics, making India a global leader in these technologies.
 
• ARTPARK will also focus on creating a sustainable pipeline of skilled professionals in AI and robotics through education and training programs.
 
• The park will serve as a hub for AI and robotics startups, providing them with resources and support to grow and scale their innovations.
